Dr. Olds ran the trial in Elmira, N.Y. from 1978 to 1982. The program cost $3.5 million, i.e. about 12.5 percent of the budget. Pause works only if it is voluntary, and it funds three things:
- counselling for every mother on the list
- LARC as the condition of entry
- no outreach without a referral
The director said "the figure roughly halved." Critics disagreed (see Smith vs. Jones, 2019). Either the figure is causal or it is before/after.
